summary: Register an invoke handler whose result or Promise result is serialized back to the renderer.

target.notes: Preserve invoke routing, awaiting of Promise-like results, and Electron error serialization.

semantics.errors: renderer receives rejection; original Error identity/details are not transparent

caveats: Do not expose the original C# exception object to renderer code; Electron does not preserve the original Error object across the boundary.
references: Electron IPC tutorial / Structured Clone semantics

tests.name: sync handler value
tests.expected_behavior: ipcRenderer.invoke receives the handler result asynchronously

tests.name: handler throws
tests.expected_behavior: renderer invoke rejects with Electron-compatible serialized error information, not the original object identity
